title: `_get_usage` cyclomatic complexity 16 (45 lines)
detail: `_get_usage` (lines 45–113) has CCN=16 across 45 lines. It dispatches on the unified-limits driver configuration, handles per-resource-class allocation lookups, manages an identity client singleton, and falls back between multiple resource-provider query patterns — all within one function. Fix: extract the resource-class lookup loop and the identity-client retrieval into separate helpers to reduce branching at each level.

title: Line 209: exception raised without `from` in except block (W0707)
detail: `raise exception.TooManyInstances(str(e))` inside `except ValueError` at line 209 does not chain the original exception. The original `ValueError` traceback is discarded, making it harder to diagnose which oslo_limit check triggered the limit violation. Fix: `raise exception.TooManyInstances(str(e)) from e`.

title: Line 143: unused argument `project_id` in oslo_limit callback
detail: `_get_usage` accepts `project_id` at line 143 as required by the oslo_limit callback interface, but the argument is never used in the function body. Fix: rename to `_project_id` to make the unused interface slot explicit.
